beginner.why: The rating explorer's One pipe view is the route the capstone lesson names. It could not be set to 0.55 of yield and printed ratings in MPa to 3 dp (500 Pa steps against tol 50) and the D over t boundaries to 4 dp (tol 5e-7). W4a adds 0.55 to the axial fractions, prints burst, collapse and collapse under tension in whole pascals and the boundaries to 10 dp. The view opens on 9-5/8 inch 47 lb/ft P-110 BTC at 0.4, so its default lands on no graded answer (panelCapstoneGuard). No prompt change.
